item.title: Version 2.2.0
item.description:
What's New in 2.2.0

A big update: record meetings on‑device, translate transcripts, generate notes with AI templates, and far better Swedish.

🎙️ Record meetings — fully on your Mac

  • Capture the meeting audio and your microphone from any video call — no bot joins the call, and nothing is uploaded. Start and stop from the menu bar while you're in the call.
  • When you stop, you name the recording and choose the language before it transcribes — nothing happens behind your back.
  • Rock‑solid: survives device changes (AirPods), sleep, low disk space, and even recovers a recording interrupted by a crash.
  • Requires macOS 15 or later for recording.

🇸🇪 Much better Swedish — KB‑Whisper

  • Added KB‑Whisper, the Swedish speech model from the National Library of Sweden — markedly more accurate on Swedish than the standard models. It's recommended automatically when you transcribe Swedish.
  • The app now picks the right engine for the language automatically: Apple's built‑in speech where it shines, KB‑Whisper / WhisperKit for Swedish and other languages it doesn't cover.

🌍 Translate transcripts

  • Translate a full transcript into any language with your chosen AI model. On‑device with Apple Intelligence or Ollama; clearly labelled when a cloud provider is used.

📝 AI Notes & templates

  • Turn a transcript into meeting minutes, action items, a SOAP note, show notes, an email follow‑up and more — one click. Create your own templates too, with a live preview before you save.
  • Summaries, translations and template results are saved with the transcript and available in the Export menu.

Refinements

  • Chat is now a full tab alongside Text, Timeline, Notes and Translate.
  • Reading‑time estimate, clearer model picker grouped by language, and many stability and polish fixes throughout.
